entries.en: Crescent windows cast narrow patches of light across the stairwell.
entries.zh: 新月形的窗户在楼梯间投下了一道道狭长的光斑。

entries.en: Our favourite prof stayed after class to explain the last diagram.
entries.zh: 我们最喜欢的那位教授下课后留了下来，解释最后那张图。

entries.en: The Populist in the novel quarrels with his neighbours over land ownership.
entries.zh: 小说中的那个民粹派成员为了土地所有权与邻居们争吵。

entries.en: The band sent a demo to the producer along with a handwritten note.
entries.zh: 乐队寄给制作人一张样本唱片，随件附了一张手写便条。

entries.meaningZh: 极可意水流按摩浴缸〔商标名〕
entries.en: We found a cracked tile beside the Jacuzzi while inspecting the bathroom.
entries.zh: 我们检查浴室时，在极可意水流按摩浴缸旁发现了一块裂开的瓷砖。

entries.en: Federated clubs kept separate accounts but shared a meeting hall.
entries.zh: 结成联盟的各家俱乐部分别记账，但共用一个会议厅。

entries.en: She compared two samples of Lycra fibre before choosing material for the costume.
entries.zh: 她比较了两份莱克拉纤维样品，然后才选定制作演出服的材料。

entries.en: After the bridge, we drove along an A-road instead of taking the motorway.
entries.zh: 过桥后，我们沿着一条A级公路行驶，没有上高速公路。

entries.en: An Afro-Caribbean poet read a short poem in the school library.
entries.zh: 一位非裔加勒比诗人在学校图书馆朗读了一首短诗。

entries.en: She insisted on an all-American set of tools for her workshop.
entries.zh: 她坚持为自己的工作室配一套全部美国产的工具。

entries.en: The driver missed our street and made a U-turn at the next junction.
entries.zh: 司机错过了我们那条街，在下一个路口掉头。

entries.en: I left my sketchbook in the hotel when we departed from Middlesbrough.
entries.zh: 我们离开米德尔斯布勒时，我把素描本落在了旅馆里。

entries.meaningZh: 通讯中代表字母C的代码词
entries.en: The radio operator repeated Charlie for C when the final letter was lost in static.
entries.zh: 最后一个字母被无线电杂音淹没后，报务员重复了代表字母C的代码词Charlie。

entries.en: Maggie carried the seedlings indoors before the storm reached our garden.
entries.zh: 暴风雨到达我们花园之前，马吉把幼苗搬进了屋里。

entries.en: We spent our last evening in Nottingham looking through secondhand bookshops.
entries.zh: 我们在诺丁汉市的最后一个晚上逛了几家二手书店。

entries.en: A postcard from Swindon arrived after my older sister had already returned home.
entries.zh: 我姐姐已经回家之后，一张从史云顿寄来的明信片才送到。

entries.en: The technician put the old Microsoft manuals in a separate archive box.
entries.zh: 技术员把旧的微软公司手册放进了一个单独的档案盒。

entries.en: Could you ask Barry to bring the folding chairs upstairs?
entries.zh: 你能请巴里把折叠椅搬到楼上来吗？

entries.en: During our stay in Oxfordshire, I drew sketches of doorways until my notebook was full.
entries.zh: 在牛津郡逗留期间，我画了满满一本门口的速写。

entries.en: Kinnock kept the spare keys in a yellow tin behind the flour.
entries.zh: 金诺克把备用钥匙放在面粉后面的一个黄色铁盒里。

entries.en: Our suitcase arrived in Cheltenham a day later than we did.
entries.zh: 我们的行李箱比我们晚一天到达切尔滕纳姆。

entries.en: Pete lowered his umbrella so that we could see the street sign.
entries.zh: 皮特放低了雨伞，好让我们看见路牌。

entries.en: Nobody noticed that Ralph had repaired the loose handle before breakfast.
entries.zh: 没人注意到拉尔夫在早餐前就修好了那个松动的把手。

entries.en: Trevor offered me the window seat and put his bag under the table.
entries.zh: 特雷弗把靠窗的座位让给了我，把自己的包放在桌子底下。

entries.en: The photograph of Ipswich slipped out when I opened the old travel diary.
entries.zh: 我翻开那本旧旅行日记时，那张伊普斯威奇的照片掉了出来。

entries.en: Eleanor recognised the missing button among the objects swept from the stage.
entries.zh: 埃莉诺在从舞台上扫下来的东西中认出了那颗丢失的纽扣。

entries.en: The archive folder on Lothian contained maps folded into narrow strips.
entries.zh: 有关洛锡安区的那个档案夹里装着折成长条的地图。

entries.en: We bought a larger envelope in Maastricht to protect the drawing during our journey.
entries.zh: 我们在马斯特里赫特买了一个更大的信封，以便在旅途中保护那幅画。

entries.en: The documentary used an old, faded photograph of Yeltsin beside a handwritten letter.
entries.zh: 那部纪录片把一张褪色的叶利钦旧照片与一封手写信并列展示。

entries.en: Robyn waited until the glue dried before moving the model from the table.
entries.zh: 罗宾等胶水干了之后，才把模型从桌上移走。

entries.en: We postponed our journey to Cheshire because the car would not start.
entries.zh: 因为汽车发动不了，我们推迟了去柴郡的行程。

entries.en: Carl borrowed my headphones but returned them with the cable neatly coiled.
entries.zh: 卡尔借了我的耳机，归还时把线卷得整整齐齐。

entries.en: Marcus caught the empty basket before it rolled down the steps.
entries.zh: 马库斯在空篮子滚下台阶之前抓住了它。

entries.en: Ms Nicholson asked us to leave the wet paintings on the rack overnight.
entries.zh: 尼科尔森女士让我们把还没干的画放在架子上过夜。

entries.en: Several old photographs of Merseyside were missing from the folder.
entries.zh: 文件夹里少了几张默西赛德郡的旧照片。

entries.en: The librarian found an old JANET guide tucked inside the computer manual.
entries.zh: 图书管理员在那本计算机手册里发现了一份夹着的旧版英国大学联合科学网指南。

entries.en: Dr Ferguson listened to the rehearsal from an empty seat near the back.
entries.zh: 弗格森博士坐在靠后的一张空座位上听了彩排。

entries.en: Gaulle wrapped the broken cup in newspaper before putting it in the bin.
entries.zh: 高尔用报纸裹住破杯子，然后才把它放进垃圾桶。

entries.en: I waved to Rory, but the crowded platform hid me from his view.
entries.zh: 我向罗里挥手，但拥挤的站台挡住了我，他没看见。

entries.en: We stayed in Hartlepool while waiting for our damaged camera to be repaired.
entries.zh: 我们在哈特尔普尔住了下来，等待受损的相机修好。

entries.en: Neville had already measured the doorway, so we knew the wardrobe would fit.
entries.zh: 内维尔已经量过门口，所以我们知道衣柜能搬进去。

entries.en: Danny drew a small star beside each question he wanted to discuss.
entries.zh: 丹尼在每道想讨论的问题旁都画了一颗小星星。

entries.en: The umbrella MacMillan lent me was still hanging beside the kitchen door.
entries.zh: 麦克米伦借给我的那把雨伞仍挂在厨房门旁。

entries.en: Hilary noticed a loose thread and fetched the sewing box from the cupboard.
entries.zh: 希拉里看见一根松脱的线头，便从柜子里取来了针线盒。

entries.en: Heseltine carefully lifted the sleeping kitten out of the laundry basket.
entries.zh: 赫塞尔廷小心地把熟睡的小猫从洗衣篮里抱了出来。

entries.en: The atlas section on the Americas includes several foldout maps and an index.
entries.zh: 那本地图册中介绍美洲的部分包括几张折叠地图和一份索引。

entries.en: Mr Leith brought a small torch to help us find the fallen earrings.
entries.zh: 利思先生带来了一只小手电筒，帮我们寻找掉落的耳环。

entries.en: Vincent set aside the cracked bowl rather than packing it with the others.
entries.zh: 文森特把那个裂了的碗单独放在一边，没有和其他碗一起打包。

entries.en: We chose a cottage in Derbyshire with enough space for all our bicycles.
entries.zh: 我们在德比郡选了一间能放下所有自行车的小屋。

entries.en: I mailed the concert programme from Dundee before catching the afternoon train.
entries.zh: 我在敦提寄出了音乐会节目单，然后赶上了下午的火车。

entries.en: Mrs Sainsbury replaced the torn ribbon on the gift with a blue one.
entries.zh: 塞恩斯伯里太太把礼物上破了的丝带换成了一条蓝色的。

entries.en: Jill saved the four corner pieces of the jigsaw for her younger sister.
entries.zh: 吉尔把拼图四角的拼块留给了自己的妹妹。

entries.en: The cake Fiona baked was still warm when the first guests arrived.
entries.zh: 第一批客人到达时，菲奥纳烤的蛋糕还热着。

entries.en: The children's Bible showed Martha standing beside a doorway in a simple line drawing.
entries.zh: 那本儿童版《圣经》里有幅简单的线描画，画着站在门口旁的马大。

entries.en: Rosie returned the library books before joining us for lunch.
entries.zh: 罗西还了图书馆的书，然后来和我们一起吃午饭。

entries.en: Sharpe checked the pocket of every coat before putting them away.
entries.zh: 夏普把外套收起来之前，检查了每件外套的口袋。

entries.en: A painted Toby stood between two chipped plates on the collector's shelf.
entries.zh: 收藏者的架子上，一个彩绘人形水罐摆在两个有缺口的盘子之间。

entries.en: The sketch I made of Everton was damaged when rain leaked into the folder.
entries.zh: 雨水漏进文件夹时，我画的那幅埃弗顿速写被弄坏了。

entries.en: The archive kept the old Novell leaflets in a drawer labelled computing.
entries.zh: 档案馆把旧的Novell公司宣传单存放在一个标着计算机类的抽屉里。

entries.en: Theda held the ladder steady while I hung the paper lantern.
entries.zh: 我挂纸灯笼时，西达扶稳了梯子。

entries.en: The parcel addressed to Guil arrived without a return label.
entries.zh: 寄给吉尔的那个包裹送到了，但没有写退件地址的标签。

entries.en: We walked back to Kensington after leaving the spare umbrella on the bus.
entries.zh: 我们把备用雨伞落在公交车上之后，步行回了肯辛顿。

entries.en: A neighbour helped us carry the boxes into our new flat in Tottenham.
entries.zh: 一位邻居帮我们把箱子搬进了托特纳姆区的新公寓。

entries.en: The researcher put the old Vauxhall brochure beside the other car manufacturers' catalogues.
entries.zh: 研究员把沃克斯豪尔的旧宣传册放在其他汽车制造商的产品目录旁。

entries.en: Ms Griffiths suggested moving the rehearsal indoors when the wind grew stronger.
entries.zh: 风变大时，格里菲思女士建议把彩排转到室内进行。

entries.en: We found Mr Lawson's missing scarf underneath a stack of folded blankets.
entries.zh: 我们在一摞叠好的毯子下面找到了劳森先生丢失的围巾。

entries.en: Mrs Robson brought a second pair of glasses to the evening workshop.
entries.zh: 罗伯森太太带了第二副眼镜来参加晚上的工作坊。

entries.en: The framed photograph of Colchester was too large for the suitcase.
entries.zh: 那张装了框的科尔切斯特照片太大，放不进行李箱。

entries.meaningZh: 斯特拉思克莱德区〔地名〕
entries.en: An old map of Strathclyde lay beneath the newspapers in the archive box.
entries.zh: 档案盒里的报纸下面放着一张斯特拉思克莱德区的旧地图。

entries.en: Dr Quinn asked everyone to check the page numbers before binding the report.
entries.zh: 奎恩博士请大家在装订报告前检查页码。

entries.meaningZh: 加雷思〔亚瑟王传奇人物〕
entries.en: The illustrator sketched Gareth in pencil before adding the other legendary knights.
entries.zh: 插画师先用铅笔勾画出加雷思，之后才添画其他传奇骑士。

entries.en: We left Harrogate with muddy boots and a bag full of unfinished drawings.
entries.zh: 我们离开哈罗盖特时，靴子上沾着泥，包里装满了没画完的画。

entries.en: Frankie remembered to bring scissors but forgot the roll of wrapping paper.
entries.zh: 弗兰基记得带剪刀，却忘了带那卷包装纸。

entries.en: Wigan lined the hem of the replica dress displayed in the sewing room.
entries.zh: 缝纫室里展示的那件仿制连衣裙，下摆内衬用了平纹棉质衬里布。

entries.en: Alain photographed the seating plan before anyone moved the tables.
entries.zh: 在有人移动桌子之前，阿兰拍下了座位安排图。

entries.en: Graeme caught up with us just as we reached the last gate.
entries.zh: 我们刚到最后一道门时，格雷姆就赶上了我们。

entries.en: Hurd left a note explaining where he had put the spare batteries.
entries.zh: 赫德留了张便条，说明自己把备用电池放在了哪里。

entries.en: Mansell lowered the music so that we could hear the announcement on the radio.
entries.zh: 曼塞尔把音乐音量调低，好让我们听清广播。

entries.en: Doreen brought an empty jar for the leftover soup.
entries.zh: 多琳拿来一个空罐子，准备用来装剩下的汤。

entries.en: The small clock Lindsey repaired now stands on our kitchen shelf.
entries.zh: 林德赛修好的那只小钟现在放在我们厨房的架子上。

entries.en: Our stop in Branson lasted longer than planned because we misplaced the car keys.
entries.zh: 因为我们把车钥匙放错了地方，在布兰森停留的时间比计划长。

entries.en: The museum volunteer dusted the old Macintosh before opening the display room.
entries.zh: 博物馆志愿者在展室开门前，擦去了那台旧Macintosh计算机上的灰尘。

entries.en: The artist sorted her photographs of the Wirral by the colour of the sky.
entries.zh: 那位艺术家按天空的颜色给自己的威勒尔半岛照片分类。

entries.en: A letter from Merrill lay unopened beneath the household bills.
entries.zh: 美林公司寄来的一封信压在家庭账单下面，还没拆封。

entries.en: Belinda noticed that one of the paper boats had begun to unfold.
entries.zh: 贝琳达注意到，其中一只纸船开始散开了。

entries.meaningZh: 徒步旅行者的行囊〔澳新旧用语〕
entries.en: In the historical play, the traveller drops his Matilda beside the campfire.
entries.zh: 在那出历史剧中，旅人把行囊放在篝火旁。

entries.en: The Auguste stumbled over an empty bucket and sent his oversized hat flying.
entries.zh: 那个笨拙型马戏团小丑被一个空桶绊了一下，硕大的帽子飞了出去。

entries.en: Ms Morrissey separated the photographs from their damaged cardboard mounts.
entries.zh: 莫里西女士把照片从已经损坏的硬纸衬板上取了下来。

entries.en: McAllister brought a measuring tape, although we had only asked for string.
entries.zh: 麦卡利斯特带来了一把卷尺，尽管我们要的只是绳子。

entries.en: A friend in Cranston offered to keep our boxes until the move.
entries.zh: 克兰斯敦的一位朋友提出，可以替我们保管箱子，直到搬家。

entries.en: Pascoe put the fragile ornaments in a basket lined with old towels.
entries.zh: 帕斯科把那些易碎的装饰品放进了一个垫着旧毛巾的篮子里。

entries.en: Larry stopped sanding the chair when he noticed the crack in its back.
entries.zh: 拉里注意到椅背的裂缝后，就停止打磨那把椅子了。

entries.en: A Shropshire stood beside the gate while the photographer adjusted her lens.
entries.zh: 摄影师调整镜头时，一只萨罗普羊站在大门旁。

entries.en: We stayed with friends in Peterborough before continuing our journey through Canada.
entries.zh: 我们先住在彼得伯勒的朋友家，然后继续在加拿大旅行。

entries.en: Judy packed the wet paintbrushes separately from the clean drawing paper.
entries.zh: 朱迪把还湿着的画笔和干净的画纸分开收好。

entries.en: My paternal aunt left her sketchbook at our flat in Scarborough.
entries.zh: 我姑妈把素描本落在了我们位于士嘉堡的公寓里。

entries.en: The family album had an entire page of old photographs taken in Nottinghamshire.
entries.zh: 那本家庭相册有整整一页都是在诺丁汉郡拍的旧照片。

entries.en: An old Barclays envelope served as a bookmark in the financial history textbook.
entries.zh: 一本金融史教材里夹着一个旧的巴克莱银行信封，当作书签。

entries.en: Mr Harper put numbered stickers on the boxes before loading them into the van.
entries.zh: 哈珀先生在把箱子装上厢式车之前，先贴上了编号标签。

entries.en: For the mythology display, the student drew Irene holding an olive branch.
entries.zh: 为了布置神话主题展板，那名学生画了手持橄榄枝的和平女神。

entries.en: Mrs Atkinson had saved the small pieces of fabric for a patchwork cushion.
entries.zh: 阿特金森太太把小块布料留了下来，准备做一个拼布靠垫。

entries.en: We reached Shrewsbury with only one clean shirt left in the suitcase.
entries.zh: 我们到达什鲁斯伯里时，行李箱里只剩下一件干净衬衫。

entries.en: Pearce offered to carry the drum while I collected the music stands.
entries.zh: 我去收拾乐谱架时，皮尔斯主动提出帮忙搬鼓。

entries.en: A small parcel from Oldham was waiting on the kitchen table.
entries.zh: 厨房桌上放着一个从奥尔德姆寄来的小包裹。

entries.en: Michelle pressed the flowers between sheets of paper inside a heavy book.
entries.zh: 米歇尔把花夹在几张纸之间，压进了一本厚书里。

entries.en: Mr Ramsay offered to repair the shelf if we could find the missing screw.
entries.zh: 拉姆齐先生提出，只要我们能找到那颗不见的螺丝，他就帮忙修架子。

entries.en: Tracey folded the empty shopping bags and tucked them behind the door.
entries.zh: 特蕾西把空购物袋折起来，塞在门后。

entries.en: Darren used a wooden spoon to retrieve the sock trapped behind the radiator.
entries.zh: 达伦用一把木勺取出了卡在暖气片后面的袜子。

entries.en: We bought extra drawing paper in The Hague after filling our last sketchbook.
entries.zh: 最后一本素描本画满后，我们在海牙又买了一些画纸。

entries.en: The clerk checked the address on an old invoice from Donaldson.
entries.zh: 职员核对了一张唐纳森公司旧发票上的地址。

entries.en: Alton placed a saucer under the leaking plant pot before wiping the table.
entries.zh: 奥尔顿先在漏水的花盆下面放了一个碟子，然后才擦桌子。

entries.en: Ashdown found the invitation tucked between two pages of the cookbook.
entries.zh: 阿什当发现那张请柬夹在食谱的两页之间。

entries.en: The idle Banbury mixer was covered with a dust sheet during the factory tour.
entries.zh: 参观工厂时，那台闲置的班伯里混炼机上盖着防尘布。

entries.en: Beth cut an extra slice of cake for the neighbour who lent us the chairs.
entries.zh: 贝丝为借给我们椅子的那位邻居多切了一块蛋糕。

entries.en: Fernando recognised his old suitcase by the green ribbon around its handle.
entries.zh: 费尔南多凭着提手上系的绿丝带认出了自己的旧行李箱。

entries.en: Mellor moved the microphone away from the street-facing window before recording.
entries.zh: 梅勒在录音前把麦克风移到了远离临街窗户的地方。

entries.en: I put the photographs of Teesside in a separate folder for our next meeting.
entries.zh: 我把蒂赛德的照片放进了一个单独的文件夹，供下次会议使用。

entries.en: Corneliu remembered the tune but needed help singing the second verse.
entries.zh: 科尔内留记得曲调，但唱第二段歌词时需要别人帮忙。

entries.en: Leonora held the curtain aside while we carried the table through the doorway.
entries.zh: 我们把桌子搬过门口时，利奥诺拉把帘子拨到了一边。

entries.en: The archivist stored the old Solaris installation discs in protective sleeves.
entries.zh: 档案管理员把旧的Solaris操作系统安装光盘装进了保护套。

entries.en: The lecturer projected a map of the Falklands before showing the travel photographs.
entries.zh: 讲师先投影出一张福克兰群岛地图，然后展示旅行照片。

entries.en: Gillian left the last page blank so that everyone could add a message.
entries.zh: 吉莉安把最后一页留白，好让大家都能写几句话。

entries.en: We returned from Buckinghamshire with a broken umbrella and three rolls of film.
entries.zh: 我们从白金汉郡回来时，带着一把破雨伞和三卷胶卷。

entries.en: At the seminar, we compared two old Tesco advertisements.
entries.zh: 研讨会上，我们比较了两则旧的特斯科公司广告。

entries.en: Ms Higgins checked that every performer had a copy of the revised script.
entries.zh: 希金斯女士确认了每位演员都有一份修改后的剧本。

entries.en: Mr Elliott asked us to remove our muddy boots before entering the studio.
entries.zh: 艾略特先生请我们先脱掉沾满泥的靴子，再进工作室。

entries.en: Our friends in Warrington kept the missing gloves until we could collect them.
entries.zh: 沃灵顿的朋友们替我们保管着那副丢失的手套，直到我们能去取。

entries.en: Mrs Forster used an old bedsheet to protect the floor from paint.
entries.zh: 福斯特太太用一条旧床单盖住地板，以免沾上油漆。

entries.en: Dr Byrne returned the borrowed atlas with a note thanking the librarian.
entries.zh: 伯恩博士归还了借来的地图册，并附了一张感谢图书管理员的便条。

entries.en: Mr Barnett counted the empty trays before closing the bakery for the evening.
entries.zh: 巴奈特先生数了空托盘，然后才结束面包店当天的营业。

entries.en: Hilda laughed when the puppy fell asleep inside her slipper.
entries.zh: 小狗在希尔达的拖鞋里睡着时，她笑了起来。

entries.en: Madeleine covered the dough with a clean cloth and cleared the kitchen table.
entries.zh: 马德琳用一块干净的布盖住面团，收拾好了厨房的桌子。

entries.en: Moira took the smaller umbrella because it fitted inside her bag.
entries.zh: 莫伊拉拿了那把较小的雨伞，因为它能放进自己的包里。

entries.en: My notebook reached Chelmsford in the parcel, but the loose photographs were missing.
entries.zh: 我的笔记本随包裹送到了切姆斯福德，但那些散放的照片不见了。

entries.en: Benn found a quiet corner where we could practise without disturbing the readers.
entries.zh: 本找到了一个安静的角落，让我们可以练习而不打扰读者。

entries.en: Ms Trafford replaced the tangled string before hanging the painted sign.
entries.zh: 特拉福德女士在挂那块彩绘招牌之前，换掉了缠成一团的绳子。

entries.en: The design student borrowed a book about McLaren for her presentation.
entries.zh: 那名学设计的学生借了一本有关麦克拉伦公司的书，准备作展示。

entries.en: Mr Cowley opened the greenhouse door so that we could bring the pots inside.
entries.zh: 考利先生打开温室的门，让我们把花盆搬进去。

entries.en: Miguel took a photograph of the broken hinge before visiting the hardware shop.
entries.zh: 米格尔先拍下了坏铰链的照片，然后才去五金店。

entries.en: Damian made room on the bench for a child carrying a large drawing.
entries.zh: 达米安在长凳上腾出地方，让一个拿着大幅画作的孩子坐下。

entries.en: The waiting-room television was showing an old interview with the singer Fergie.
entries.zh: 等候室的电视正在播放一段对歌手菲姬的旧采访。

entries.en: Fergus kept the spare candles in a drawer beside the torch.
entries.zh: 费格斯把备用蜡烛放在手电筒旁边的抽屉里。

entries.en: Alexei found the recipe difficult to read because someone had spilled tea over it.
entries.zh: 有人把茶洒在食谱上，阿列克谢因此觉得上面的字很难辨认。

entries.en: Edouard brought the finished model downstairs without waking the sleeping dog.
entries.zh: 爱德华把做好的模型搬到楼下，没有吵醒熟睡的狗。

entries.en: Klerk pulled the empty suitcase from beneath the bed and checked its wheels.
entries.zh: 克勒克从床底下拉出空行李箱，检查了一下轮子。

entries.en: Hari arrived with a basket of apples and stayed to help wash the dishes.
entries.zh: 哈里带来了一篮苹果，还留下来帮忙洗碗。

entries.en: Felipe placed the rehearsal schedule beside the door where everyone could see it.
entries.zh: 费利佩把彩排时间表放在门旁，让大家都能看见。

entries.en: The suitcase we lost in Fallon was returned with both locks still fastened.
entries.zh: 我们在法隆丢失的行李箱被归还时，两把锁都还锁着。

entries.en: The old NetWare manuals were packed beside the installation discs in the archive.
entries.zh: 档案库里的旧NetWare网络操作系统手册和安装光盘装在了一起。

entries.en: Ronni brought the photograph closer to the lamp to examine the faded handwriting.
entries.zh: 龙尼把照片移近灯光，查看上面已经褪色的手写字迹。

entries.en: Burun picked up the scattered pencils while I searched for the missing eraser.
entries.zh: 我寻找丢失的橡皮时，布伦捡起了散落的铅笔。

entries.en: Molla held down the lift's door-open button until we had brought in all the boxes.
entries.zh: 莫拉一直按着电梯的开门键，等我们把所有箱子都搬了进去。

entries.en: We returned to Bournemouth to collect the painting we had left with a friend.
entries.zh: 我们回到伯恩茅斯，去取留在朋友那里的画。

entries.en: Our journey through Cambridgeshire ended with a picnic beside the rented cottage.
entries.zh: 穿过剑桥郡的旅程结束时，我们在租来的小屋旁野餐。

entries.en: The postcard from Staffordshire had a coffee stain across half the message.
entries.zh: 那张从斯塔福德郡寄来的明信片上有块咖啡渍，覆盖了半段留言。

entries.en: Fulhams were hidden inside the gambler's sleeve in the final scene of the play.
entries.zh: 那出戏的最后一场中，赌徒的袖子里藏着作弊用的假骰。

entries.en: We caught a bus to Hampstead to return a borrowed violin.
entries.zh: 我们乘公交车去汉普斯特德归还借来的小提琴。

entries.en: The flat in Islington had a narrow hallway where our bicycles barely fitted.
entries.zh: 伊斯灵顿的那套公寓有一条狭窄的走廊，我们的自行车勉强能放进去。

entries.en: We stopped in Doncaster to replace the drawing board damaged during our journey.
entries.zh: 我们在唐卡斯特停了下来，更换途中损坏的画板。

entries.en: A friend in Luton lent us enough folding chairs for the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 卢顿的一位朋友借给了我们足够彩排使用的折叠椅。

entries.en: Murdoch forgot the picnic blanket but remembered the tin opener.
entries.zh: 默多克忘了带野餐毯，却记得带开罐器。

entries.en: The envelope from Warwickshire contained a small watercolour and no letter.
entries.zh: 那个从沃里克郡寄来的信封里装着一幅小水彩画，没有信。

entries.en: We left the spare suitcase with friends in Wolverhampton before continuing our journey.
entries.zh: 我们把备用行李箱留在伍尔弗汉普顿的朋友那里，然后继续旅行。

entries.en: Beverley found his missing glove beneath the passenger seat of the van.
entries.zh: 贝弗利在厢式车副驾驶座底下找到了自己丢失的手套。

entries.en: Monica laid the damp photographs flat rather than clipping their corners to a drying line.
entries.zh: 莫尼卡把潮湿的照片摊平，没有夹住边角把它们挂在晾晒绳上。

entries.en: Mrs Bentley brought a shallow box so that the painted eggs would not roll around.
entries.zh: 宾利太太拿来一个浅盒子，免得彩绘鸡蛋滚来滚去。

entries.en: We carried the repaired lamp back to our friend's flat in Brixton.
entries.zh: 我们把修好的灯带回了朋友位于布里克斯顿的公寓。

entries.en: Rees noticed that the last page of the music had fallen behind the piano.
entries.zh: 里斯发现乐谱的最后一页掉到了钢琴后面。

entries.meaningZh: 亨伯赛德郡〔旧行政区名〕
entries.en: The researcher unfolded a map of Humberside taken from a box of old council records.
entries.zh: 研究员展开了一张从旧议会档案盒里取出的亨伯赛德郡地图。

entries.en: The archivist compared two old aerial photographs of the Brent oilfield.
entries.zh: 档案管理员比较了两张布兰特油田的旧航拍照片。

entries.en: The photographs we took on the Gower were mixed with the postcards in a cardboard box.
entries.zh: 我们在高尔半岛拍的照片和明信片混放在一个纸箱里。

entries.en: Maclean covered the window glass with paper before we began painting the frame.
entries.zh: 我们开始给窗框刷漆之前，麦克莱恩先用纸遮住了窗玻璃。

entries.en: We left our bags in Chichester while collecting the repaired camera.
entries.zh: 我们去取修好的相机时，把行李留在了奇切斯特。

entries.en: The parcel from Huddersfield contained the gloves we had left behind.
entries.zh: 那个从哈德斯菲尔德寄来的包裹里装着我们遗落的手套。
